title: Handover of a handover of a handover
author: NeverLucky159
selftext:
Handover inception 

So Claude told me to set the autocompact at 400K and then compact manually around 250k to 400K and to compact only one or two times and then create a handover file and start a new chat. 

The issue is that the 300K context fills quite quickly in like 1 hour or 2 hours maximum, and without finishing the current task of just creating a very small part of a level. So basically I have to compact and create handovers all the time. Is this normal or am I doing something wrong?

I read in some threads here some people compact at 150k which would mean compacting every 15-30mins

comments.author: PhotoDisastrous8275
comments.body: Your Claude.md or what ever files your updating during the handoff might need to get looked at. You need to keep those handoff files lean otherwise you just fill up the context when you start a new session

comments.author: Mother-Hedgehog-5628
comments.body: its not always black and white, it depends on the size and complexity of the job - simple jobs and well understood tasks should just be in its own fresh chat with a handover, things that need lots of cached knowledge to complete is better to bundle and run longer chats and handle them in a single batch running much higher so its not just trying and failing in a loop and forgetting all the knowledge it took to get there.

comments.author: frigginwizard420
comments.body:
thats what I'm doing. I tried to get it to do it itself, but it doesnt seem to want to.  

I just have the coordinator write a handoff file so the new coordinator knows which agents are working on which tasks and then it clears itself.
